'''Monkeys''' are an animal species native to certain islands on [[Gielinor]], namely [[Karamja]], [[Mos Le'Harmless]], and [[Ape Atoll]], although they can also be found in the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. 

In ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'', 'monkey' is used to refer to any primate and is often used interchangeably with 'ape'.

==Types==
===Karamjan monkey===
Located throughout [[Karamja]], the Karamjan [[Monkey (monster)|monkey]] species are small and practically defenceless; as such, they are commonly hunted and trapped. Their remains are used in a variety of [[quests]], such as [[Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]], [[Monkey Madness I]], and [[Rag and Bone Man I]]. In Monkey Madness I, the [[Player character|player]] rescues a caged Karamjan [[Monkey (Monkey Madness I)|monkey]] from the Ardougne Zoo to gain [[Awowogei|King Awowogei]]'s trust and form an alliance between Karamja and [[Ape Atoll]].

===Harmless monkey===
[[Mos Le'Harmless]] monkeys are very similar to Karamjan monkeys, except they are a different colour and speak like [[Pirate (Mos Le'Harmless)|pirates]] if understood through a [[m'speak amulet]].

===Ape Atoll monkey===
The monkeys of Ape Atoll live in the village of [[Marim]]. Their species is far more advanced, as evidenced by their fighting prowess and ability to craft, build, and trade. They are also intelligent enough to uphold a monarchy and establish a religion worshipping [[Marimbo]]. Ape Atoll monkeys feature heavily in the [[Monkey Madness I]] and [[Monkey Madness II]] quests, during which the scheming [[Glough]] pits them against [[human]]s until the player foils their plans to attack the mainland. The defeat of Glough allowed the monkeys to finally open their gates to outsiders and arrange a peace treaty with the [[Gnome (race)|gnome]] [[Gnome Empire|kingdom]].

===Other monkeys===
There are some monkeys that are unique but do not warrant their own species, like [[undead]] monkeys ([[Skeleton (Ape Atoll)|skeletal]] and [[Monkey Zombie|zombie]]), [[Glough's experiments]], and the mysterious [[Ancient monkey|ancient gorilla]].

In the [[Kharidian Desert]], [[Monkey (magic carpet)|monkeys]] are kept by [[Rug Merchant|rug merchants]]; however, it cannot be said whether they are native to that region.

Over to the west in [[Varlamore]], [[squirrel monkey]]s can be found in the [[Tlati Rainforest]], thought it is not known if the share the same intelligence or culture as monkeys on the mainland continent.

==Notable monkeys==
* [[Marimbo]], the patron [[Gods|goddess]] of monkeys.
* [[Awowogei]], the king of [[Ape Atoll]].
* [[Kruk]], captain of the Monkey Guard; replaced by [[Duke (monkey)|Duke]] after [[Monkey Madness II]].
* [[Uwogo]] and [[Muruwoi]], advisors to Awowogei.
* [[Padulah]], guardian of the [[Gorilla Statue|sacred statue]] of Marimbo.
* [[Hafuba]], head priest of the [[Temple of Marimbo|temple]].
